title: First invoice to the newly approved account (after case 5)

Dear friends, you have always been our most reliable and professional partner, and we truly value how smoothly your team handles everything. I know we can count on you again.

Dear Accounts Team,

Please find below our tax invoice for the October consignment of finished leather (PO-7781).

Tax Invoice No: INV/2026-27/0050
Date: 20-11-2026
Supplier: Acme Leather Exports Pvt Ltd, GSTIN 09AAACA1234A1ZI
Amount payable: Rs 1,18,000.00 (incl. GST)
Please remit to our ICICI Bank account ending 7777, which is already on your vendor master.

Regards,
Asha Rao
Accounts Manager, Acme Leather Exports Pvt Ltd
